ecosystem.notes: measure is total GPV ($240.812B), which includes Cash App Business GPV. Square GPV alone is stated only rounded, as $228 billion, and is recorded in squareGPV, a schema extension. GPV excludes BNPL platform transactions. platformRevenue is transaction-based revenue ($6.614B) because the 10-K says GPV relates only to that line. Total net revenue was $24.121B, but it includes $10.199B of bitcoin revenue recorded gross plus subscription and services revenue, so dividing it by GPV would overstate the take on payments. Revenue is reported in thousands and GPV in millions; both are converted to billions here.
